We need to call this function twice: once for 2010 with category "Drama" and once for 2012 with category "Comedy". Actually they want all Drama and Comedy movies that Leonardo DiCaprio starred in 2010 and 2012 respectively. So we need two calls: one for 2010 drama, one for 2012 comedy.

We should call the function with actor_name="Leonardo DiCaprio", year=2010, category="Drama". Then call again with actor_name="Leonardo DiCaprio", year=2012, category="Comedy".
